svg.title: iOS · Gallery · preview sheet on an imported photo (INFO + METADATA from the file) · portrait
svg.desc: Mirrors App/GalleryView.swift (compact branch — the .sheet(isPresented: $showPreviewSheet) block, which wraps App/GalleryPreviewPanel.swift in a NavigationStack with a "Close" cancellationAction) with App/MetadataPanelSections.swift, as shipped 2026-09-13 (data model Milestone 1), code first, mirrored from the running iPhone 16 Pro simulator after Steven's sign-off. THE SHEET a single tap on a Gallery tile raises on an iPhone (on iPad and Mac the same GalleryPreviewPanel is the fixed 300pt pane — macOS/gallery.svg and gallery.metadata.svg). It rises over the dimmed Gallery — the parent's top edge peeks 10pt above it — with a 10pt corner radius, LL.cardBackground (the panel's own background; its ScrollView's is hidden), and "Close" 17pt regular in LL.accent leading 16 (baseline 106). The project is _WEX3518, the Sony ARW + Lightroom .xmp sidecar of the Milestone 1 test set, imported through Create ▸ Import photos (the import copies; the original is never touched). PANEL, top to bottom, in the sheet's 365pt column (14pt each side): the 150pt thumbnail at cornerRadius 10 (tap it for ProjectMediaPreviewSheet), 22pt under the bar; the title (16pt bold: the file name) over the 12pt secondary date · size line (31. 8. 2026 · 18,9 MB); the action grid — Open alone on top, filled LL.accent, then one row of equal buttons Edit · Text · Shapes (57pt each, rx 9, a 16pt medium glyph over an 11pt medium label, 8pt gaps; no New clip — a Photo capture is one asset); a full-bleed Divider 16pt under; then, 12pt down and 14pt apart, the record groups: no scope switch for a photo (an interval project draws components/metadata-scope.* here), INFO (components/metadata-info.photo.phone.svg — camera, lens, exposure, captured in the file's own zone, GPS with the Open in Maps link, size with the format, software) and METADATA (components/metadata-fields.file.phone.svg — the IPTC Core record with its origins: from file for what the sidecar carried, edited here + revert on Title, nothing on the empty rows; UIKit's .roundedBorder fields are 33pt here against the Mac's 22, and Copyright status is an accent .menu label rather than a popup button). The screen edge catches the sheet after Title; everything below is reached by scrolling and is drawn under the clip: the rest of the group, then Keywords — the seven dc:subject keywords from the sidecar in the shared tag editor (components/tag-field.imported.phone.svg) under a label the panel draws, marked from file — then Storage alone among the metaRows and the Rename · Share · Delete… footer (three equal buttons; Finder is macOS-only). Every value shown here is in Projects/<id>/assets.ndjson (this asset's line: bytes, SHA-256, the imported layer, the edited layer with per-field editedAt/editedBy) and metadata.json (the project-level record); edits write the edited layer only. STATES NOT DRAWN: an interval project's sheet (the scope switch and a per-frame INFO — metadata-scope.frame.narrow.svg draws the stepper), the "Reading the files…" copy INFO shows before the reader lands, a revert, the tag picker sheet (project-tags.portrait.svg). MEASURED from the iPhone 16 Pro simulator (402×874 pt): the sheet's top edge at 70 there, 69 on this canvas; thumbnail 83pt under it; a 3-button row at (365−16)/3 = 116.3pt each.
